newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Ayala Land 97 1st qtr net 1.42 bln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Ayala Land 97 1st qtr net 1.42 bln pesos.

text.p: Ayala Land Inc said on Tuesday its first quarter net income reached 1.42 billion pesos in the first quarter of 1997, up from 1.24 billion in the same period last year.
Total consolidated revenues of the firm from January to March reached 3.21 billion pesos.
The country's premier land developer said its land sales, primarily from Ayala Southvale, Madrigal Business Park and Laguna Technopark, contributed 541 million pesos or 17 percent of total revenues.

It also said its properties for lease along the Ayala commercial and business district contributed about 506 million pesos or about 16 percent of consolidated revenues, up 24 percent compared with the same period in 1996.
Earnings derived by Ayala Land from its ongoing condominium project, both office and residential buildings, contributed 483 million pesos or 15 percent to gross revenues, it said in a statement.
Sales growth of the company's condominium projects grew by 24 percent over the same period in 1996.

The Pineridge, Ayala Land's first residential development project in the northern mountain resort city of Baguio has been nearly sold out after less than two months from launch, with 92 of 102 units sold, the company said.
"This impressive take-up rate indicates the presence of a healthy condominium market in the area," it said.
Besides the Pineridge project, Ayala is also completing construction of four other condominium projects.
Revenues from construction projects of wholly-owned Makati Development Corp contributed 12 percent of total revenues or 376 million pesos, 35 percent higher than the previous year's level.
The firm's middle-income housing unit, Laguna Properties Holdings Inc, contributed 146 million pesos or five percent of consolidated gross earnings, it said.
Higher occupancy levels and room rates of hotels owned by Ayala Land improved revenues by nine percent to 213 million pesos.
Other revenue sources in the first quarter of the year include interest and other investment income which contributed 29 percent or about 946 million pesos to consolidated revenues.
Ayala Land said it remained confident that it would continue to post healthy growth levels for the rest of the year.
The firm has forged recently a joint venture with Redland Plc and the Siam Cement Public Co Ltd to engage in the manufacture of concrete roof tiles.

The Philippine real estate conglomerate, through unit Ayala International Properties Pte Ltd, has also acquired a building in the central business district of Sydney in Australia as part of its thrust to diversify and to form strategic alliances with other companies this year.
